title: Crime Pays but Botany Doesn't
summary: A personal blog website featuring curated reading lists at the intersection of crime studies and botany, presenting a quirky collection of resources that explore unconventional academic and popular culture crossovers between criminology and plant sciences.
problem_solved: Provides niche, curated reading recommendations for readers interested in the unusual combination of crime/true crime topics and botanical/plant science literature.
why_valuable: Offers a unique, idiosyncratic reading list that bridges two seemingly unrelated fields, appealing to readers seeking unconventional intellectual explorations.
